notes: MI 2010 mirrors MI 2015 structure exactly: 4-level tree (chapter > act > section), 23 sections in Act 472 of 1978 (Lobby Registration Act, MCL 4.411-4.431), single-act regime so no support_chapter picks. Repealed predecessor Act 214 of 1947 (Legislative Agents, MCL 4.401-4.410) also appears under chapter-4 but is excluded as repealed. No parallel executive-branch lobbying regime in MI. Notable URL-convention difference vs. 2015: at 2010 vintage Justia uses hyphen-separated section slugs (section-4-411) where 2015 preserves the dot (section-4.411). Cloudflare clear on all three Playwright fetches; HTML sizes 79KB / 65KB / 63KB.
